course_name: 都市數據進階分析與模型應用
outline:
課程大綱：

當代都市議題經常為跨領域、開放性的複雜問題，在資料蒐集與分析上，需要整合地理空間、時間的維度；在分析與對策上，須平衡公部門、私部門、民眾等多重利害關係者的，是一門相當複雜但重要的學問。本課程從真實的都市議題出發，教導學生掌握地理空間資訊、資料分析、資料建模、資訊視覺化、策略論述等綜合能力，培養學生對於都市複雜議題的觀察與剖析，進而對真實環境提出洞見與創意。

本課程為進階課程，具備程式語言基礎、地理資訊系統概念為佳。透過分組操作實際都市議題，學習各類API使用、地理運算、模型選擇、模型建立、模型解讀、資料視覺化等應用。包含一次期中報告，與一次期末成果報告。

Contemporary urban issues are complex, requiring integration of geographical, temporal dimensions in data collection and analysis. Balancing the interests of stakeholders like the public, private sectors is crucial. This course focuses on real urban issues, teaching skills in geographical information, data analysis, modeling, visualization, and strategic discourse. It aims to cultivate students' ability to observe, analyze urban issues, and propose insights for real environments. It's an advanced course, requiring basic programming and GIS concepts. Through group projects, students learn API usage, geographic computation, model building, and data visualization. The course includes one midterm report and one final project report.

分組期末成果 40%： 各組期中簡報的成果總體評比，同一組每個成員評分相同。

Individual Course Participation 30%: Comprehensive assessment of regular class attendance, participation in discussions, weekly progress, etc.
Group Midterm Results 30%: Overall evaluation of each group's midterm presentation results, with the same score given to each member within the same group.
Group Final Results 40%: Overall evaluation of each group's final presentation results, with the same score given to each member within the same group.
